• Multiple calls to refresh control endpoints suggest potential inefficiencies in the workflow.
• User authentication processes are consistently followed across various workflows.
• The system demonstrates stable performance with no errors in API responses.
• Further analysis of refresh call patterns may reveal opportunities for optimization.
• Clear relationships between UI actions and API calls enhance understanding of user interactions.
